fixed_tasks.request: add one bounded option to an existing command
repair a reproducible regression in one module
restore an error path without changing its public contract
add a cross-module behavior with persisted state
migrate an existing workflow contract and its knowledge

rules: Keep model, tools, initial codebase, and acceptance criteria fixed.
Run each method in an isolated environment.
Do not let an implementation agent rewrite the acceptance criteria.
Record unavailable token usage as unavailable rather than estimating it.
